decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed creation of  3 residential units is considered to be an excessive and inappropriate development of this building within a  small site. It will result in an excessive residential density, leading to an inadequate standard and layout of residential accommodation for future occupiers, with poor light, outlook and disabled access, inadequate amenity space provision, problems of parking, poor ventilation and air quality, and excessive noise and vibration, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, H 4.1, ENV-P.1.5, ENV-P.1.6 and T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan, associated Supplementary Planning Guidance, Brentford Area Action Plan Policies BAAP1 and BAAP4,  and Policies 3.4 and  3.5 of the London Plan and the Mayoral Draft Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Change of use from a hall into 3 self-contained units comprising one x one bed flat, one x two bed flat and one studio unit incorporating alterations to provide cycle parking, refuse/recycling storage and infilling of front boundary wall to enclose the existing forecourt
